reviews.review:
This is my all time favorite game ever. Here says I have played a bit less than 200 hours. This is because I bought it on Steam not very long ago. I had it before and my time was around 1000 hr. 
At first it was very difficult, but the ability to choose between different characters and playing styles lets you find out what your favorite player is, and eventually develop your own playing style.
I also love how addictive it is. The perma-death makes it really exciting, especially when you have advanced further on the levels or are playing many rounds. I lack the vocabulary to express this, but getting killed when you have advanced so much makes you angry enough to start over right away. Same thing happens when you are starting and playing well, and get killed.
Another thing that makes me want to play over and over is that, when you get skilled enough, it is very rare that you get killed, but seeing clouds of enemies exploding, many coins flowing to you, having so many power-ups that you barely move gives me such a serotonin rush that I just keep circling through the levels.

In short if you love Candy Crush and killing monsters, this game is for you.
This is honestly one of the best games I have ever played. It's simplicity makes it better than its sequel and I would without a doubt recommend it to anyone. More than worth the price.
